t: This is the former Dollis Hill Synagogue, in Brent. It served an Orthodox Jewish congregation worshipping in the Ashkenazi rite from 1938 until 2011. It was designed by Owen Williams, a British engineer and architect. He was principal engineer for the original Wembley Stadium, and later worked on the Gravelly Hill Interchange and modernist buildings such as the Express Building in Manchester. So a small suburban synagogue comes from a designer of much larger landmarks.
